title: PLACEHOLDER: Carrow County — resident services portal
source_material:
PLACEHOLDER — fictional, written for the CCR MCP proof of concept. Carrow County is not a real organisation and none of this happened. Replace with a real, approved case study before testers see it.

DELIVERY LEAD'S SUMMARY (project close-out)

Carrow County serves about 410,000 residents. Permits, licences and service requests lived in eleven separate systems, each with its own form and its own phone line.

We ran a nine-month engagement:
- Service design research with residents and front-desk staff across four departments.
- A single resident portal and account, built on the county's existing cloud tenancy, with an AI assistant that answers questions from approved county content only.
- Migration of the six highest-volume services onto the portal.

MEASURED RESULTS (from the county's digital services dashboard, first year)
- 58% of requests for the six migrated services now start online, up from 22%.
- Call volume to the permits line fell 35%.

CLIENT INTERVIEW — Elena Ortiz, Chief Digital Officer (notes)
"Residents stopped needing to know how the county is organised to get something done."

NOT FOR PUBLICATION
- Budget figures are pending board approval and must not be quoted.
